title: Proclamation: Colon Cancer Awareness Month
text: Summary. In 2023, I drafted this proclamation recognizing Colon Cancer Awareness Month, which was subsequently adopted to encourage early screening, public education, and support for patients and caregivers.

title: Proclamation: Colon Cancer Awareness Month
text:
Why It Matters

Early detection saves lives. Screening can identify precancerous polyps and early-stage cancers.
Disparities persist. Access, awareness, and follow-up care vary across communities.

title: Proclamation: Colon Cancer Awareness Month
text:
My Role
As the drafter of the proclamation, I aimed to highlight both the importance of prevention and the need to address disparities in colorectal cancer care.

title: Proclamation: Colon Cancer Awareness Month
text:
Call to Action

Talk to a healthcare provider about the right screening schedule for you.
Share reliable resources and support local awareness efforts.
Advocate for equitable access to screening and follow-up care.

title: Epigenetic Age Acceleration and Disparities in Posttraumatic Stress in Women in Southeast Louisiana
text: Summary. This paper investigates whether epigenetic age acceleration—methylation-based estimates of biological aging exceeding chronological age—is associated with posttraumatic stress and related health disparities among women in Southeast Louisiana. Leveraging data from the NIMHD Social Epigenomics Program, the study examines links between stress exposures, DNA methylation clocks, and PTSD measures, highlighting the potential of epigenetic biomarkers to illuminate social and environmental drivers of mental health inequities.

title: Epigenetic Age Acceleration and Disparities in Posttraumatic Stress in Women in Southeast Louisiana
text:
Context & Motivation
Why epigenetic clocks matter in stress-related disorders and how social determinants may influence biological aging.

title: Epigenetic Age Acceleration and Disparities in Posttraumatic Stress in Women in Southeast Louisiana
text:
Methods (at a glance)

Cohort: Women in Southeast Louisiana

Measures: PTSD assessments; DNA methylation–based epigenetic clocks

Approach: Associations between PTSD indicators and age acceleration

title: Epigenetic Age Acceleration and Disparities in Posttraumatic Stress in Women in Southeast Louisiana
text:
Key Takeaways

Higher epigenetic age acceleration was observed alongside greater posttraumatic stress indicators.
Results underscore the value of integrating social epigenomics with mental health research.
